name: soundcraft-mcp-server
description: MCP server for SoundCraft: multitrack sessions from audio files and synth or drum notes, effects, busses, mixdowns with loudness, stems, MIDI, audio processing and conversion, with SoundCraft's own engine, from Claude (Windows, macOS, Linux).

scripts.pack:mcpb: npm run build && npx -y @anthropic-ai/mcpb pack . soundcraft-mcp-server.mcpb

author: Jhon Supelano (https://github.com/jhonsu01)

codex.shortDescription: Make songs, mix multitrack audio and process sound with your local SoundCraft
defaultPrompt: Make an 8-bar drum and bass loop at 110 BPM and export WAV and stems
Mix these voice and music files into a podcast intro with fades
Normalize these recordings and convert them to 16-bit FLAC
